evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Football odds feed with pre-match odds across many markets; documented with a Premier League fixture example.

evidence_items.source_title: All Premier League Data available in our Premier League API
evidence_items.claim_summary: Premier League squads, stats, lineups, predictions and odds are covered; odds feed documented a Premier League fixture example.

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Odds are attributed per bookmaker (bookmaker_id in responses) across 120+ international bookmakers.
evidence_items.notes: Operator-attributed prices, not a single aggregated price.

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: A stable bookmaker_id identifies each operator; a published bookmaker sheet lists all bookmakers with their ids.
evidence_items.notes: Raw/source operator identity only; not a LadybugBets canonical operator id.

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Odds are tied to fixtures identified by a fixture with named participants and a date (e.g. Crystal Palace vs Arsenal, Premier League).
evidence_items.notes: Raw/source event identity with participant components.

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Feed covers many markets including Match result (the 1X2 equivalent).

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Each market exposes labelled outcomes (e.g. home/draw/away for Match result).

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Each odd carries latest_bookmaker_update, the timestamp of the bookmaker's latest update (per-odd freshness / when that bookmaker last changed its price).
evidence_items.excerpt: latest_bookmaker_update — Timestamp of the bookmaker's latest update.
evidence_items.notes: A bookmaker-originated quote-update time, not merely an API response time.

evidence_items.source_title: Football Odds Feed – Premium API for Betting | Sportmonks
evidence_items.claim_summary: Opening odds are documented and each subsequent change stored, with that history kept up to 7 days after kick-off.
evidence_items.excerpt: keep that history available for up to 7 days after kick-off.
evidence_items.notes: Provider-side history window is limited (7 days post kick-off); LadybugBets retention of pulled data is a separate rights question.

evidence_items.claim_summary: Using the data to create something and earning money from that creation is permitted.
evidence_items.excerpt: if you use our data to create something based on our data and start earning money from your creation, everything is fine.

evidence_items.claim_summary: Storage of the data provided by the services is allowed.
evidence_items.excerpt: distribution, transfer, and storage of data provided by our services is allowed

evidence_items.claim_summary: Storage of the data is allowed, supporting retention of pulled observations for historical analytics.
evidence_items.excerpt: distribution, transfer, and storage of data provided by our services is allowed
evidence_items.notes: Reselling data as data remains prohibited; retention for own use is distinct from resale.

evidence_items.claim_summary: Creating derived products based on the data is permitted.
evidence_items.excerpt: if you use our data to create something based on our data ... everything is fine.

evidence_items.claim_summary: Reselling Sportmonks' data as data is not allowed without prior approval.
evidence_items.excerpt: Reselling Sportmonks' data without approval is not allowed ... you cannot directly sell the data we provide.
evidence_items.notes: Redistribution as a feed reportedly requires written approval (a case-by-case conversation), so the default posture is prohibited.
